recipes.name: Oven Baked Tofu Shakshuka
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Add all the traybake ingredients to a 9 x 12 inch (23 x 31 cm) baking dish*.
Mix together, then bake in the oven for 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, mix together the kala namak and turmeric on a plate. Coat the tofu slices lightly with this turmeric mix.
Place the tofu on top of the tomato mixture and press the pieces in a bit. Transfer the baking dish back into the oven and let it bake for another 10 to 15 minutes.
Serve with toasted pitas, and garnish with za'atar, cilantro, and lemon slices if desired. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † If you don't love spice, consider using less. † Kala namak, also known as Himalayan black salt, is a salt often used in South Asian cuisine. The sulphur compounds give the salt an egg-like smell and flavour. * For the oven, we used top and bottom heating (not fan-assisted/convection). The shakshuka can alternatively be cooked on the stove in a wide pan with a lid.
Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days.
